b1-02.title: Light cabinetry with a glass display
b1-02.description: Pale, plain-front cabinets sit alongside a dark-framed glass display and open shelves. Warm linear lighting, a wood-look central surface and curved edges give the composition a calm, continuous feel.
b1-02.alt: Light cabinetry with a glass display — Decorative cabinetry & display

b1-03.title: Wall workstation with full-height storage
b1-03.description: A continuous wall desk provides several computer stations and drawers beneath. Tall pale cupboards, dark open shelves and wood-look wall panels bring work and storage into one orderly arrangement.
b1-03.alt: Wall workstation with full-height storage — Workstation

b1-04.title: Light executive desk and illuminated bookcase
b1-04.description: A large desk pairs neutral tones with a dark top and warm lighting across its front. Open shelving and fluted surfaces behind the desk echo the room's lines.
b1-04.alt: Light executive desk and illuminated bookcase — Executive office

b1-05.title: Geometric reception counter with linear detailing
b1-05.description: An angled white surface meets horizontal wood-look strips. Vertical lines on the wall behind create an orderly backdrop for a reception area.
b1-05.alt: Geometric reception counter with linear detailing — Reception counter

b1-06.title: White and wood-look reception with linear light
b1-06.description: A wood-look counter meets a white panel with a sloping edge. Warm light traces the junction, picking out its shape against simple walls and surrounding wood-look finishes.
b1-06.alt: White and wood-look reception with linear light — Reception counter

b1-07.title: Dark wood-look desk and storage
b1-07.description: An executive desk and matching storage combine dark wood-look surfaces with black detailing. Open shelves, closed cabinets and a glazed section provide places for files and display objects.
b1-07.alt: Dark wood-look desk and storage — Executive office

b1-08.title: Meeting room behind glass partitions
b1-08.description: A large rectangular table, brown chairs and a dark display wall define the meeting area. Black-framed glazing and white ceiling fins give the room a clear architectural rhythm.
b1-08.alt: Meeting room behind glass partitions — Meeting room

b1-10.title: Open office with an exposed ceiling
b1-10.description: Rows of white desks, drawer units and black chairs fill an open workspace. Exposed services, pendant and linear lights establish an industrial character, while plants provide visual separation.
b1-10.alt: Open office with an exposed ceiling — Open office

b1-11.title: Shared workspace with a graphic wall
b1-11.description: Light desk surfaces, dark legs and grey dividers form shared workstations. An exposed dark ceiling and linear lighting sit above a graphic wall with yellow and blue accents.
b1-11.alt: Shared workspace with a graphic wall — Open office

b1-12.title: Minimal office with white desks
b1-12.description: White desks and black chairs are arranged in a bright office with glass partitions. Under-desk drawers, wood-look desk organisers and a small seating area complete the setting.
b1-12.alt: Minimal office with white desks — Open office

b1-13.title: Pale green cabinetry with upper glass displays
b1-13.description: Smooth, glossy pale green fronts meet a light worktop and white apron-front sink. Dark-framed upper displays and warm lighting above, below and within the cabinets reveal the layers of the composition.
b1-13.alt: Pale green cabinetry with upper glass displays — Kitchen & cabinetry

b1-14.title: Green and white U-shaped kitchen
b1-14.description: Pale green and white cabinetry wraps around three sides of the kitchen. Light veined surfaces, black appliances, tall cabinets and linear ceiling lighting create a continuous composition.
b1-14.alt: Green and white U-shaped kitchen — Kitchen & cabinetry

b1-15.title: Kitchen in warm wood-look tones
b1-15.description: Wood-look lower cabinets sit beneath warm neutral upper units. A light worktop, black integrated appliances and under-cabinet lighting connect with a coordinated dining table and pendant lights.
b1-15.alt: Kitchen in warm wood-look tones — Kitchen & cabinetry

b1-16.title: Framed green cabinets and dark glass displays
b1-16.description: A long kitchen combines framed green fronts, black handles and dark-framed glass displays. Light veined surfaces and lighting inside and beneath the cabinets provide a gentle contrast.
b1-16.alt: Framed green cabinets and dark glass displays — Kitchen & cabinetry

b1-17.title: Breakfast counter with a fluted front
b1-17.description: Wood-look upper cabinets meet grey lower units. A breakfast counter with vertical fluting, a pale top and concealed lighting forms the focal point, with illuminated shelves and slim pendants nearby.
b1-17.alt: Breakfast counter with a fluted front — Kitchen & cabinetry

b2-01.title: Dark wall bookcase with integrated lighting
b2-01.description: Open shelves, lower cabinets and vertical wood-look panels form a wall of storage. Dark tones, fluted detailing and warm shelf lighting bring storage and display together.
b2-01.alt: Dark wall bookcase with integrated lighting — Office bookcases & storage

b2-02.title: Angled view of an illuminated bookcase
b2-02.description: This angled view shows dark open shelving, plain doors and wood-look sections. Warm shelf lighting gives depth to the combination of open display and closed storage.
b2-02.alt: Angled view of an illuminated bookcase — Office bookcases & storage

b2-03.title: Black coffee point with linear wall panels
b2-03.description: Black cabinetry, a sink and a coffee machine form a compact drinks area. Vertical wood-look panels and a continuous shelf add warmth to the dark palette.
b2-03.alt: Black coffee point with linear wall panels — Pantry & break area

b2-04.title: White and wood-look reception with concealed light
b2-04.description: An elongated counter combines wood-look panels with a stepped white frame. Concealed light emphasises its horizontal form beneath pendant lights in a minimal setting.
b2-04.alt: White and wood-look reception with concealed light — Reception counter

b2-05.title: Navy kitchen with a wood-look island
b2-05.description: Navy cabinets surround an island with wood-look surfaces. Open shelves, black pendants and island seating balance deep colour with a warm-looking texture.
b2-05.alt: Navy kitchen with a wood-look island — Kitchen & cabinetry

b2-06.title: Minimal executive desk in a dark room
b2-06.description: A wood-look desk surface, pale detailing and a dark side drawer unit sit against grey walls. A narrow wall shelf and black furniture reinforce the simple geometric lines.
b2-06.alt: Minimal executive desk in a dark room — Executive office & desk

b2-07.title: Executive desk with coordinated storage
b2-07.description: A large wood-look desktop meets a dark base and side storage. The bookcase behind combines closed panels and open shelving in the same palette.
b2-07.alt: Executive desk with coordinated storage — Executive office & desk

b2-08.title: Executive room with warm wall panels
b2-08.description: A wood-look desk, pale panels and illuminated display shelves define this office. Continuous wall treatments and concealed ceiling light connect the different elements.
b2-08.alt: Executive room with warm wall panels — Executive office & desk

b2-09.title: Compartmented wardrobe accessory drawer
b2-09.description: A close view shows separate compartments for watches, glasses, belts and jewellery. Wood-look surfaces, gold-toned handles and internal light draw attention to the storage arrangement.
b2-09.alt: Compartmented wardrobe accessory drawer — Wardrobes & dressing areas

b2-10.title: Bright open office with planter dividers
b2-10.description: Pale workstations sit beneath suspended linear lighting and a grid ceiling. Wood-look storage with integrated planters separates desks from circulation paths.
b2-10.alt: Bright open office with planter dividers — Open office

b2-11.title: Executive desk with a curved base
b2-11.description: A wood-look desktop with rounded corners sits above a dark curved side section. The bookcase behind combines open shelving, glazing and lower cabinets beside a window seating area.
b2-11.alt: Executive desk with a curved base — Executive office & desk

b2-12.title: Linear kitchen within a wood-look frame
b2-12.description: Pale lower units and fluted upper cabinets sit inside a continuous wood-look frame. Concealed lighting, integrated appliances and a narrow display section complete the kitchen wall.
b2-12.alt: Linear kitchen within a wood-look frame — Kitchen & cabinetry

b2-13.title: Workspace with a warmly lit wall bookcase
b2-13.description: A simple wood-look desk faces a wall of cabinets and open shelving. Warm shelf lighting, brown and neutral tones and a pale chair create a quiet atmosphere.
b2-13.alt: Workspace with a warmly lit wall bookcase — Executive office & desk

b2-14.title: White shared desks with planted dividers
b2-14.description: Rows of white desks and drawer units sit beside grey dividers lined with plants. Exposed ceiling services and suspended linear lights add an industrial character to the orderly layout.
b2-14.alt: White shared desks with planted dividers — Open office

b2-15.title: Office storage with asymmetric shelves
b2-15.description: Closed cabinets, drawers and asymmetric open shelves form a varied storage composition. Grey, wood-look and dark surfaces provide space for files, books and display objects.
b2-15.alt: Office storage with asymmetric shelves — Office bookcases & storage

b2-17.title: Galley kitchen in grey and wood-look tones
b2-17.description: Grey base units sit beneath wood-look upper cabinets and a high storage row. Under-cabinet lighting, a pale veined splashback and track lights illuminate the working surfaces.
b2-17.alt: Galley kitchen in grey and wood-look tones — Kitchen & cabinetry

b2-18.title: Tall cabinet with an open middle section
b2-18.description: A pale cabinet combines wood-look doors and grey internal shelves. The open central section provides display space, while several open doors reveal the interior arrangement.
b2-18.alt: Tall cabinet with an open middle section — Office bookcases & storage

b2-19.title: Office pantry and staff dining area
b2-19.description: White and wood-look cabinets, drinks equipment and round tables form a small dining area. A blue wall, dark ceiling and ring-shaped lights distinguish it from the formal workspace.
b2-19.alt: Office pantry and staff dining area — Pantry & break area
